_tenDayTrendNote: Every 10-day series here is the mathematical carry-forward of 2026-09-09's own committed trend (shift left by one, dropping its oldest point), the same chain-trust approach 2026-09-09's own note used — not a fresh re-read of each historical point. Only the newest (Thu 10 Sep) point in each series is a genuinely new reading, computed from this report's own confirmed cover totals: answerRatePct = 231/243 = 95%; accepted = 231; missed = 12 (all three from the explicit "Total Inbound Calls = 243 / Accepted Calls, 231, 95% / Missed Calls, 12, 5%" cover chart). overallAvgWaitSec's new point (28) is the one number left over in its chart's garbled text once every other point matched the known chain — medium confidence, not independently corroborated elsewhere.
_queuesNote: Same chain-trust method as the top-level tenDayTrend: positions 0-8 of every per-queue series are the carry-forward of 2026-09-09's own committed arrays, cross-checked against the surviving (non-dropped) values in today's garbled per-queue chart text at every position where a value was legible — all matched exactly. Newest-day (position 9) values: Appointments/General Enquiries accepted+missed confirmed against this report's own accepted/missed-by-queue pie charts (131/8 and 96/4); Health Professionals/Canberra Vasectomy accepted+missed confirmed the same way (0/0 and 3/0). Per-queue avgWaitSec newest-day values are lower confidence: Appointments (42) and Canberra Vasectomy (44) are the one leftover unmatched number in their respective chart text once the known chain values were accounted for; Health Professionals (0) carries forward unchanged (matches the chain, no distinguishable new figure in the text); General Enquiries (35) also carries forward unchanged — its chart text left two ambiguous leftover candidates (34 and 29) that could not be confidently attributed, so the prior value was kept rather than guess between them.
